ref: University Physics 1 §10.5 Calculating Moments of Inertia
excerpt: the moment of inertia for any object depends on the chosen axis.

reviewedMappings.2015-3-03:0: Equations 10.19/10.20 support integral and parallel axes. Original explicitly specifies central perpendicular axis and common linear density. Ring integral=2pi mu R^3; each chord length sqrt(3)R and offset R/2 gives sqrt(3)mu R^3/2. Exact normalized direct integration independently matches parallel-axis result.
